User Defined Inputs to Power Model

The CCDR-EEX assumptions 'National Policies in APS World" and a mix of other sources are used at the global level. Simple averages of multiple sources are used at the national level; indexation to the CPAT year when no more recent data is available. A script is available to automate the process.

CapEx, variable and fixed OpEx are in USD/kW,
capacity factor and efficiency are in percentage
total lifetime and construction time are in years
CCDR-EEX (WBG), Way et al. (2022), IRENA, GNESTE, BNEF

For solar and wind, the decline in CapEx over time is included. Two scenarios are used: (1) Medium = uses CCDR-EEX Assumption "National Policies in APS World"; (2) High = uses National PD2050 in NZE World Scenario.
Decommissioning and transmission costs are based on estimates provided by several data sources. The average is computed and then trasnformed to be expressed as percentage of CapEx.
Decomissioning costs (Raimi, 2017; WNA, 2023; Water Power & Dam, 2009) & Transmission costs (Andrade & Baldick, 2017)
Data are directly retrieved from the LUT model and interpolated when missing.

Battery: CapEx, variable and fixed OpEx are in USD/kWh
Battery interface: CapEx and fixed OpEx are in USD/kW and variable OPEX in USD/kWh
WaterElectrolysis: CapEx and fixed OpEx are in USD/kW and variable OPEX in USD/kWh
Lifetime in years
Data prior to 2019 is from the EIA, data aftet 2019 is from IRENA. A script is available to update forward looking data.
